desc: Derive the exact partial-order characterization: a black cell conflicts with a white cell iff the black cell is weakly southeast of it.
Implement and validate an \(O(M\log M)\) descending-column sweep detecting a black/white dominance conflict, including equal-column handling.
Prove sufficiency conceptually using the downward closure of all prescribed black cells.
Check edge cases in the implemented sweep: equal rows/columns, grid borders, and all-black/all-white constraints.
